summary: Phase S2 passes final boundary review at remediation baseline e8d317b7. BND-001 through BND-006 are closed: all supported package exports build and load, replay/version/date/size and numeric inputs are strictly rejected, balancing and queue work are bounded, placement validates graph/options before provider invocation, and the runtime remains provider/app/DB/env neutral.
nonblocking_findings: The shared engine dependency graph remains deliberately small and acyclic: core and practice-core depend on Zod; practice depends on core, practice-core, and Zod; SRS depends on practice-core, ts-fsrs, and Zod.
SRS lint continues to report four inherited warnings already documented by the implementation role; none is a provider, boundary, contract, or runtime error.
evidence: Baseline identity: HEAD and requested final-review baseline both resolve to e8d317b75849a443166a289a8d9dbb86c3682950.

BND-004: balanceDueDate rejects windows beyond the finite maximum before candidate iteration; queue remediation is also capped by maxReviewsPerDay.
